name: KooKoo AI Alt Text Creator
author: micromax

sections.description:
AI Alt Text Creator is a lightweight, powerful plugin that uses Artificial Intelligence to analyze your images and automatically generate SEO-friendly Alt Text and Titles.

Instead of locking you into a specific AI provider with expensive subscriptions, this plugin connects to OpenRouter, giving you access to the world’s best AI models (like Google Gemini 1.5 Flash, GPT-4o, Claude 3.5 Sonnet) at the lowest possible cost.

Key Features:

One-Click Generation: Instantly generate descriptions for individual images directly from the Media Library list view.

Background Processing (Cron): Process your entire library automatically in the background without slowing down your site.

Context-Aware: Uses the parent post’s Title and Content to generate descriptions that are relevant to the specific article where the image is used.

Cost Control: You pay only for what you use via your own OpenRouter key.

Detailed Logs: See exactly when an image was processed and if any errors occurred directly in the “Edit Media” screen.

Why use OpenRouter?

OpenRouter is an AI model aggregator that offers significant benefits for WordPress users:

Cheaper: Models like Google Gemini 1.5 Flash are incredibly affordable (often free for low usage or cents for thousands of images).

Flexible: You can switch between models instantly. If a new, better model comes out next week, you can use it immediately.

No Middleman: You use your own API key, meaning no markup on token costs.

Examples of Global Context:
Inputs:
– Page Topic: [{post_title}]
– Page Content: [{post_content}]
– Image: [attached image]

Examples of Alt Text Prompt:
Role: Web Accessibility and SEO Expert.
Task: Generate a single, optimized alt text string (MAX 125 characters) for the provided image, situated within the context of inputs.

Examples of Alt Text Prompt:
Role: SEO Copywriting Specialist.
Task: Generate 1 optimized image title based on the provided topic and attached image.

External Services

This plugin relies on OpenRouter as a third-party service to provide Artificial Intelligence capabilities.

Service Name: OpenRouter

Service URL: https://openrouter.ai/

Data Sent: Image URLs, Post Titles, and Post Content (context) are sent to OpenRouter API for processing.

Terms of Service: OpenRouter Terms https://openrouter.ai/terms

Privacy Policy: OpenRouter Privacy Policy https://openrouter.ai/privacy

Note: You must obtain your own API key from OpenRouter to use this plugin.

Configuration

Step 1: Get your API Key

Go to OpenRouter.ai and sign up.

Navigate to your Account settings and find the Keys section.

Create a new Key (e.g., named “WordPress”).

Copy the key (starts with sk-or-…) and paste it into the OpenRouter API Key field in the plugin settings.

Step 2: Select a Model

The plugin defaults to google/gemini-flash-1.5 because it is fast and cost-effective.

To use a different model, browse OpenRouter Models.

Copy the model ID (e.g., openai/gpt-4o-mini or anthropic/claude-3-haiku).

Paste this ID into the AI Model field in settings.

Step 3: Setup Bulk Generation

Enable Run automatically in background.

Set Batch Size to 1 or 2 (recommended to prevent server timeouts).

Set Interval to 5 minutes.

Save changes. The plugin will now process your older images in the background.
sections.installation:
Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.

Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.

Navigate to Settings > AI Alt Text to configure the plugin.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin modify my actual image files?

No. It only updates the metadata (Alt Text and Title) in the WordPress database.

Will it overwrite my existing Alt Text?

Bulk Generation: No. The background process skips images that have already been processed by plugin to save you money.

Manual Generation: Yes. If you click the “Regenerate” button on a specific image, it will overwrite the existing text.

What happens if I uninstall the plugin?

If you delete the plugin via the Plugins screen, it will clean up its own settings and temporary data. However, the Alt Text and Titles generated for your images will remain, as they are part of your site’s content.

Fixed issue where failed images would block the bulk generation queue.

Added uninstall.php for clean removal of plugin data.

Initial release.
